item.title: Bethel’s Amariano Sikes signs letter with Southern Oregon
item.description: The Jaguar cornerback who transferred from ELITE High for his senior year put pen to paper on Wednesday afternoon to sign a letter of intent to play football and study at Southern Oregon University.

item.title: Flu surge shows need for vaccination
